name: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd.
summary: Chengdu Gas Group Corporation Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise primarily engaged in the provision of urban gas services. As of December 31, 2020, the company managed an extensive operational footprint, which included a 7,155-kilometer pipeline network, three gas storage facilities, three gas filling stations, six gas distribution stations, seven gate stations, and 13,300 pressure regulation units. This infrastructure was utilized to serve approximately three million residential customers. Originally established in 1967, the firm was previously known as Chengdu Gas Company and maintains its corporate headquarters in Chengdu, China.
